question.prompt: When comparing \((a+1)^2\) and \(a^2+1\), first calculate the part of the difference excluding the constant terms. Given that the difference equals \(2a\), what is the difference when \(a=3\)?

solutions.explanation: \((a+1)^2-(a^2+1)=2a\). When \(a=3\), the difference is 6, so the former is greater.
solutions.title: Evaluate the given difference
